task: Repair Click progress-bar completion so batched updates render the truthful final position

subtasks.description: Freeze and reproduce Click issue 3571 on the current default branch
lessons: A terminal buffer whose isatty method returns true makes progress rendering deterministic without sleeps or a real terminal.

subtasks.description: Query AEG after the failing oracle and before diagnosis
lessons: The 0.05-threshold query correctly abstained; generic repair vocabulary at 0.0179 did not justify reuse.

subtasks.description: Flush residual batched progress during finalization and add a focused regression
lessons: When intermediate rendering intentionally batches state, the terminal transition must commit any residual state before declaring completion.

subtasks.description: Verify the frozen oracle, focused tests, full terminal UI module, full suite, lint, and formatting
lessons: Force the TTY path in the project regression because Click intentionally skips positional updates for non-TTY output.

constraints: Preserve blindness until the pre-diagnosis AEG query completes.
Do not weaken update_min_steps batching during ordinary iteration.
Keep the repair and regression within Click's documented contribution path and per-task budget.
Do not push, open a pull request, comment upstream, or represent local verification as maintainer acceptance.
lessons: A completion transition must flush residual state that is intentionally held below an intermediate update threshold.
A black-box TTY buffer can reproduce terminal-state defects deterministically without timing delays.
A correct retrieval abstention prevents unrelated low-similarity experience from steering a fresh repair.
A passing local upstream suite supports contribution readiness but does not supply external acceptance or promotion evidence.
